prerequisites.rationale_text: The representativeness heuristic is a System 1 shortcut. Detecting and overriding it requires System 2 engagement to pause intuitive categorization and force comparison against base rates, alternative classes, or regression effects.
prerequisites.source_quote: Instead of dealing with the difficult question of calculating probability (System 2 work), System 1 substitutes it with the easier question of similarity or resemblance.

curation_notes.summary: The RH article explicitly frames the heuristic as System 1 and its correction as System 2. Detection requires System 2 override.
